categories.name: Robot Framework Fundamentals: The Stranded Protocol
categories.description: Master the core concepts of Robot Framework through an engaging story-driven curriculum. Two robots crash-land on planet Syntax-IV and must write test suites to repair their ship.

categories.name: Mastering BuiltIn Library
categories.description: Deep dive into Robot Framework's BuiltIn library. Master every keyword, understand edge cases, and become proficient with variables, assertions, and control flow keywords.

categories.name: API Testing with Robot Framework
categories.description: Learn to test RESTful APIs using Robot Framework. Cover HTTP methods, authentication, JSON validation, and advanced testing patterns.
